Subject: DPA annex / cross-border safeguards — initial evidence request

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move toward procurement, our legal and security teams need a short inventory of the materials you can provide for the DPA annex and DPF evidence mapping. Specifically:

- A copy of the DPA annex template you expect to sign (including cross-border clauses)
- Operational controls and dataflow diagram showing where EU/US requests are routed
- SOC 2 summary or attestation (or equivalent)
- KMS/HSM key custody details and any subprocessor list for transit/processing

We have a compressed procurement timeline and would appreciate an initial package by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-12). Can you also flag anything that typically causes delay on your side so procurement can plan?

Appreciate it — happy to schedule a short call if that helps.

Best,
Laura Briggs
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Halcyon Health
[Attachment: Halcyon_DPF_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel, 85KB)]

Subject: Re: DPA annex / cross-border safeguards — initial evidence request

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (sales / procurement lead) and Neha (privacy) to help pull the pack together.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide a redlineable DPA annex (attached v2) with cross-border exhibits and standard fallback routing language.
- Dataflow diagram and export map attached (png).
- SOC 2 summary attached; full report available under NDA.
- We use customer-managed KMS via supported providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) for Private deployments; for hosted accounts we offer Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys. We will include a short KMS/HSM note in the packet.

What would help us: if you can confirm which legal basis you expect us to reference for EU->US transfers (SCCs + DPF supplement, or a specific derogation/path). Also, do you have any confirmation required on subprocessors beyond the high-level list?

We will aim to deliver the materials by EOD 8/12. If procurement needs a separate SOW / pricing worksheet, Marissa will follow up.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura / team,

Thanks Laura — quick note from procurement side. We have a standard SOW and pricing appendix that aligns to Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private deployments. Key items to flag for timeline planning:

- Signed DPA annex + SCCs + any DPF supplement accepted = gating item for contract execution.
- Dedicated capacity procurement (if chosen) requires ~6 week lead time for GPU pool assignment and network onboarding.
- Private (VPC) onboarding typically adds 3–4 weeks for network and KMS integration testing.
- If you require an on-prem package, that is a separate engagement and lead time varies by site readiness.

I've attached our SOW template and a pricing worksheet. For the purposes of an initial purchase order, customers often sign the DPA + SOW and then select deployment mode during onboarding; we can include target dates in a mutual action plan.

Proposed next steps:
1) Legal to review our DPA annex (David attached).
2) Halcyon to confirm data transfer legal basis preference (SCCs + DPF supplement or other).
3) Procurement to confirm desired deployment mode so we can provide firm timelines/pricing.

I'll follow up tomorrow with a short MAMP (mutual action plan) draft.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_SOW_template.docx (MS Word, 95KB)]
[Attachment: pricing_workbook.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]

David / Marissa —

Appreciate the rapid response and the attachments. A few clarifying items from legal:

1) DPF / SCCs: we intend to reference SCCs + DPF supplement. Please confirm your standard DPF annex text and whether Redwood supports the fallback routing language to a US-only processing variant if DPF is not accepted by regulators.

2) KMS / Key custody: we need a short statement confirming whether keys can be customer-controlled for Hosted accounts (we understand Private supports customer KMS). If not, we need details on key lifecycle and HSM provider.

3) Subprocessors: can you provide a CSV with subprocessor name, country, role, and last-attested date? We will include that in our vendor assessment.

4) Data retention: any default retention windows for transient logs and KV cache (typical defaults and config options).

Attached is a short questionnaire that highlights the specific fields we need filled. If you can provide answers and the subprocessor CSV by EOD today (8/12), we can keep to our procurement timeline. Otherwise we will need a 48–72 hour extension.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
External Counsel, Halcyon Health

Tom / Laura — thanks for the questions. Quick status and commitments: 

- DPA annex v2 (attached) includes the standard Redwood DPF exhibit. We support SCCs + DPF supplement; the annex also contains optional routing language for a US-only processing fallback. We'll provide a redline-friendly version for your counsel.
- KMS: for Hosted accounts we offer Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys; we can also enable a customer-managed key option for Hosted on a limited basis under a separate controls addendum. We'll include a KMS lifecycle note in the packet.
- Subprocessors: attached is a CSV export from our supplier registry with name/country/role/last-attested date.
- Retention defaults: KV cache default is 7 days for ephemeral sessions; request/response token logs default to 90 days (configurable per contract). We'll include exact config knobs and SLO impacts in the evidence pack.

Next steps:
- We will upload a consolidated evidence folder to the Drive link below by EOD 8/12.
- Marissa will send a MAMP and pricing rows for your review tomorrow.
- Propose 30-minute call to walk through the DPF exhibit and KMS options: available 8/13 between 9–12 PDT or 8/14 14–17 PDT. Please let us know preferred slot.

Shared evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_redwood_evidence_pack
DocuSign (DPA envelope draft): https://app.docusign.com/links/ABC12345-signature-request

Regards,
David Kim
